en: A monochrome postcard-style photograph showing a large, monumental early‑20th‑century building with steep tiled roofs, small cupolas, tall narrow windows and heavy masonry walls. The architecture is somewhat expressionist or Art Nouveau, with a massive, almost fortress‑like appearance and minimal ornament. In the upper right corner of the card, the number "1597" is written in red ink. No printed caption or other text is visible on the front.
